fields.description:
Provision the per-client bearer PATs the `static` verifier authenticates (ADR
deft-evolutive-mosasaur) and the repo-root local-only client-credential config the epic asks for,
treated like every other box secret: SSM-sourced, materialized on-box, gitignored, never committed.
Single concern: the credential material + its safe delivery — client-side config wiring is olm.

## Approach + rationale (SSM-materialize, NOT rsync — gotcha f600)
The `.env` on the box is rsync-EXCLUDED, so a rotated SSM secret never reaches the box via source
sync. The bearer PATs must therefore be materialized on the box from SSM at deploy time, exactly
like the existing `opcert-guard.map.conf` materialization pattern (a separate SSM-sourced file that
nginx/the app reads), NOT baked into the rsync'd tree. A pure value-rotation (no git change) does
NOT advance `main`, so autodeploy no-ops on it — rotation is operator-driven (re-materialize +
reload), which the runbook must state.
- Terraform SSM params for the per-client PATs (one per client: copilot/codex/claude) under the
  existing `/rebar/prod/` prefix; `fetch-secrets.sh` wiring to materialize them on the box.
- The `static` verifier's accepted-token set is sourced from those materialized secrets.
- A **repo-root local-only** client-credential config TEMPLATE (committed) + a real gitignored file
  it renders to, so an operator wiring a client has a documented shape but no secret is ever
  committed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tier: **real file/CLI + a committed-secret guard test** (test-design §3 CLI + §6 contrast). Oracles:
  - The gitignored real credential path is matched by `.gitignore` and a guard test asserts `git
    check-ignore` returns it AND that no file in the tree contains a real PAT pattern (the negative
    control: the template with a placeholder passes; a planted real-looking secret fails).
  - `fetch-secrets.sh` materializes the PAT file from SSM into the on-box location the `static`
    verifier reads (assert via a stubbed SSM/aws sink feeding a known value → the materialized file
    contains it; the file is NOT under the rsync'd tree).
  - Config-effect contrast (§6): the `static` verifier accepts a request bearing a materialized PAT
    and rejects an unknown token (401) through the real read path.
- [ ] The runbook documents operator-driven rotation (re-materialize + reload; autodeploy no-ops on a
  value-only rotation).

## Compat / rollback
Additive (new SSM params + materialization). Rollback = remove the params + materialization step;
no existing secret path changes. Never commits a secret (enforced by the guard test above).

Depends on: deft-evolutive-mosasaur (ADR fixes the auth mode = static bearer). Blocks:
unmythical-uninspired-olm (client configs need the PAT values).
